metadata.name: Parqués
metadata.description: Playable Colombian Parqués definition for two to four players. Each player has four pieces, uses two dice, needs doubles to leave jail, receives three attempts while all pieces are jailed, captures rivals outside safe squares, must reach heaven by exact count, and rolls again after doubles. A turn moves one piece by the sum of both dice; split-die movement and regional house rules are omitted.

error.value: Parqués requires two to four players.
